creator: sofia.reyes
title: Charred Lemon Chicken Thighs
description: Weeknight sheet-pan chicken with a bright, slightly bitter lemon crust. The thighs go in skin up and stay that way.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C fan.
Toss the chicken with the olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, chilli flakes and a generous amount of salt.
Spread the lemon slices over a sheet pan and sit the thighs on top, skin up. Do not crowd them.
Roast for 25 minutes, until the skin is deeply browned and the lemon slices have caught at the edges.
Rest for 5 minutes before serving, and spoon the pan juices back over the top.

creator: luca.bianchi
title: Rigatoni with Tomato and Torn Basil
description: The sauce is four ingredients and it needs all four. Do not skip the butter at the end.
steps: Put a large pot of well salted water on to boil.
Warm the olive oil in a wide pan and cook the garlic gently until it smells sweet but has taken no colour, about 2 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, season, and simmer for 15 minutes until the sauce pulls away from the side of the pan.
Cook the rigatoni until just short of the packet time, then move it into the sauce with a mugful of the pasta water.
Add the butter and toss hard over the heat for 1 minute until the sauce turns glossy and clings.
Off the heat, fold through the basil and half the parmesan. Serve with the rest on top.

creator: kenji.watanabe
title: Gochujang Butter Noodles
description: Ten minutes, one pan, and a sauce that emulsifies itself if you keep the noodle water.
steps: Boil the noodles in unsalted water for 4 minutes, then lift them out and keep a cup of the water.
Melt the butter in the empty pan and add the garlic and gochujang. Cook for 1 minute until the paste darkens slightly.
Add the soy sauce, honey and a splash of noodle water and swirl until it comes together into a smooth sauce.
Return the noodles and toss for 2 minutes, adding more noodle water until the sauce coats every strand.
Finish with the spring onions off the heat.

creator: sofia.reyes
title: Sheet Pan Harissa Salmon
description: Salmon and broccoli on one tray, with harissa doing all of the work.
steps: Heat the oven to 200C fan.
Toss the broccoli with 2 tablespoons of the oil and a good pinch of salt, spread it on a sheet pan and roast for 8 minutes.
Meanwhile mix the harissa with the remaining oil and rub it over the salmon.
Push the broccoli to the edges, sit the salmon in the middle, and roast for 10 minutes until the fish flakes at the thickest part.
Serve with the lemon wedges.

creator: priya.nair
title: Red Lentil Dal with Fried Curry Leaves
description: A everyday dal. The tempering at the end is not optional, it is the dish.
ingredients: rinsed until the water runs clear
steps: Put the lentils, water and turmeric in a pot and bring to a boil, skimming off the foam that rises.
Turn the heat down and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring now and then, until the lentils have collapsed into a loose puree. Season well.
In a small pan, heat the coconut oil until it shimmers.
Add the cumin seeds and wait for 30 seconds until they crackle, then add the curry leaves, garlic, ginger and chilli. Fry for 1 minute until the garlic is pale gold.
Pour the whole pan over the dal and stir it through just before serving.

creator: amara.okafor
title: Black Bean and Sweet Potato Tacos
description: Roast the sweet potato hard enough to get real edges on it. Soft cubes make sad tacos.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C fan.
Toss the sweet potato with the oil, cumin, paprika and plenty of salt, and spread it in a single layer with space between the cubes.
Roast for 20 minutes, then add the black beans to the tray and roast for 5 minutes more.
Warm the tortillas directly over a gas flame or in a dry pan until they blister.
Fill the tortillas, top with avocado and coriander, and squeeze over the lime.

creator: amara.okafor
title: Thai Red Curry with Tofu
description: Fry the paste properly before the coconut milk goes in. That step is the difference.
steps: Heat the oil in a wide pan and fry the tofu until it is golden on at least three sides, about 8 minutes. Lift it out.
Add the curry paste to the same pan and fry for 2 minutes until it darkens and smells toasted.
Pour in the thick cream from the top of the coconut milk and cook for 2 minutes until the oil separates out.
Add the rest of the coconut milk, the soy sauce and the sugar, then the broccoli and pepper. Simmer for 6 minutes.
Return the tofu, warm it through, and finish with the lime juice off the heat.

creator: luca.bianchi
title: Slow Braised Beef Ragu
description: A Sunday sauce. Three hours mostly unattended, and it freezes well in portions.
steps: Season the beef well and brown it hard in the oil, in batches, until every piece has a dark crust. Set it aside.
Lower the heat and cook the onion, celery and carrot in the same pot for 12 minutes until soft and sweet.
Add the garlic for 1 minute, then the tomatoes, stock, rosemary and the beef with any resting juices.
Cover and cook at a bare simmer for 3 hours, until the beef falls apart under a spoon.
Shred the meat into the sauce, check the seasoning, and let it sit for 10 minutes before serving.

creator: kenji.watanabe
title: Crispy Chilli Prawns
description: The cornflour coating has to be thin and dry. Wet prawns steam instead of crisping.
steps: Toss the prawns in the cornflour so each one carries a thin, even dusting. Shake off the excess.
Heat the oil until it shimmers and fry the prawns in a single layer for 90 seconds a side. Lift them out.
Pour off most of the oil, then add the garlic, ginger and chilli and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the soy sauce and honey and let it bubble for 1 minute until syrupy.
Return the prawns, toss once to coat, and scatter over the spring onions.

creator: noor.haddad
title: Halloumi and Courgette Traybake
description: Salty, charred, and ready in half an hour. Good hot, better at room temperature.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C fan.
Toss the courgettes and tomatoes with 2 tablespoons of oil and the oregano and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the halloumi, turning it in the pan juices, and roast for 10 minutes more until the cheese is blistered in places.
Squeeze over the lemon and scatter with mint just before serving.

creator: sofia.reyes
title: One Pot Chicken and Rice
description: Everything cooks in the same pot, and the rice takes on all of it. Do not lift the lid early.
steps: Season the chicken and brown it skin down in the oil until the skin releases easily and is deep gold, about 8 minutes. Set aside.
Cook the onion and pepper in the fat for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and paprika for 1 minute.
Stir in the rice until every grain is coated, then pour in the hot stock and season.
Sit the chicken on top, skin up, bring to a simmer, cover and cook on low for 20 minutes.
Take it off the heat and leave it covered for 10 minutes. Scatter with parsley to serve.

creator: kenji.watanabe
title: Miso Mushroom Udon
description: Brown the mushrooms in silence first. Crowding them is the only way to get this wrong.
steps: Heat a dry pan until very hot and add the mushrooms in one layer. Leave them alone for 4 minutes, then stir and cook 3 minutes more until browned.
Add the butter and garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Whisk the miso and soy sauce with 100ml of hot water and pour it in.
Add the cooked udon and toss over the heat for 2 minutes until the sauce coats the noodles.
Top with spring onions.

creator: noor.haddad
title: Chickpea and Herb Salad with Tahini
description: More herb than leaf. The dressing needs more water than you expect before it goes creamy.
steps: Whisk the tahini with the lemon juice and garlic. It will seize and look wrong.
Add cold water a tablespoon at a time, whisking, until it loosens into a pourable cream. Season it firmly.
Toss the chickpeas, herbs, cucumber and tomatoes together in a wide bowl.
Pour over the dressing and fold it through just before serving.

creator: amara.okafor
title: Smashed Avocado on Sourdough with Chilli
description: Toast the bread until it is genuinely dark. Pale toast collapses under the avocado.
steps: Toast the sourdough until the edges are dark and it sounds hollow.
Smash the avocado roughly with the lime juice and a good pinch of salt. Leave it lumpy.
Pile it onto the toast, drizzle with olive oil and finish with chilli flakes and more salt.

creator: noor.haddad
title: Spiced Cauliflower Grain Bowl
description: Roast the cauliflower until parts of it are almost too dark. That is where the flavour is.
steps: Heat the oven to 220C fan.
Toss the cauliflower with the oil, cumin and salt and roast for 25 minutes without turning it, until the edges are dark.
Stir the tahini and lemon juice into the yogurt and loosen with water until it pours.
Spoon the barley into bowls, top with the cauliflower, and pour over the dressing. Finish with parsley.

creator: kenji.watanabe
title: Egg and Spinach Fried Rice
description: Cold rice only. Fresh rice turns to paste and there is no way back from it.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a wok until it smokes lightly, pour in the eggs and scramble them for 30 seconds while still soft. Tip them out.
Add the rest of the oil and the garlic, then the rice. Press it flat and leave it for 1 minute at a time so it catches.
Add the spinach in handfuls and toss until it collapses.
Return the eggs, add the soy sauce down the side of the wok, and toss for 1 minute.
Finish with spring onions.
